units.source_text: 我也觉得有这个可能，可又觉得有些奇怪。

en.t: I too thought that might be possible, but I also felt it was somewhat strange.

units.source_text: 好歹把哥哥和妹夫都叫回来了，我怎么能扔下病危的父亲不管，跑到东京去呢！

en.t: After calling both my elder brother and my sister's husband back, how could I abandon my critically ill father and run off to Tokyo?

units.source_text: 我跟母亲商量之后，决定给先生回电，说现在回不去，

en.t: After discussing it with my mother, I decided to telegraph Sensei back and say that I could not return now,

units.source_text: 还尽可能简要地说明了父亲现在病情很严重。

en.t: and I also explained as briefly as possible that my father's condition was now very serious.

units.source_text: 但是仍然觉得不妥，我又写了一封详细说明为什么回不去东京的信，当天发了出去。

en.t: But that still did not feel sufficient, so I wrote another letter explaining in detail why I could not return to Tokyo and sent it out that same day.

units.source_text: 母亲认定是关于我拜托先生找工作的事情，非常惋惜地说：“真不是时候啊，没办法。”

en.t: My mother was convinced it had to do with the job I had asked Sensei to find for me, and said with great regret, "The timing really is unfortunate; it cannot be helped."
